source.code:
/--
`Associative op` indicates `op` is an associative operation,
i.e. `(a ∘ b) ∘ c = a ∘ (b ∘ c)`.
-/
class Associative (op : α → α → α) : Prop where
  /-- An associative operation satisfies `(a ∘ b) ∘ c = a ∘ (b ∘ c)`. -/
  assoc : (a b c : α) → op (op a b) c = op a (op b c)
